selectionHint: The selected trip's message IDs bound one source read. Query completion does not prove complete physical GPS coverage.
endpointsOnly: No sampled path is available in this selection. The list and map retain the trip's original endpoint records.
unavailable: Position samples could not be loaded. The trip endpoints remain available; retry the bounded read.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Positions are retained from the last successful bounded read; its retrieval time remains visible.
utcHint: Event samples use the UTC edt clock from the bounded source read. Trip endpoint times remain unchanged; no time zone is inferred from them. Source and message ID identify each row; different messages at the same time or coordinates remain separate.
edataNotLoaded: eData/CAN samples have not been loaded for this trip.
absent: Not present in the loaded set

reasons.CAR_NOT_FOUND: The selected truck was not returned by the source.
reasons.UPSTREAM_FAILURE: The bounded source request did not complete. This is not an empty trip.
reasons.INCOMPATIBLE_SOURCE: The source response could not be reconciled with the selected message window.
reasons.ROW_LIMIT: The source row limit was reached. These positions describe only the loaded subset.
reasons.BOUNDARIES_MISSING: At least one trip boundary message is absent from the loaded subset. This is a partial position selection.

briefTitle: Trip and selected point brief / export
evidenceHint: The local JSON file contains this trip, the loaded position-read metadata and only the selected point, if any. It keeps source units and times. Export does not load more data.
includeCoordinates: Include trip and selected point coordinates
